style: Say clearly and steadily, like a trusted radio news reader
lines: The vendor's proposal is on the table. Tap any option in the panel, and watch Jordan's day and the council respond.
Counsel has flagged a section. Tap a different option in that section to fix it.
No legal flags. Press Call the vote when you're ready.
Members leaning no have named one change. Press Close, then choose the suggested clause and option.
The council will now vote on the draft.
The motion fails. Press Ask the room, or change a section.
Pinned drafts sit side by side. Press Load into Draft on any column to keep working on it.
No drafts pinned yet. Press Back to Draft, then Pin draft.
